unlisted_practices: Rewriting hospital clinical trial FAQ content with an LLM prompted for comprehension and empathy to improve public attitudes and participation intentions
Examining moderators of AI-generated health communication effects, such as age, race, and treatment fears, using the Theory of Planned Behavior

screen.reason: The study conducts a randomized survey experiment comparing original hospital FAQs to GPT-4o rewritten FAQs on patient/public attitudes toward clinical trials, evaluating the tool's impact rather than a specific operational deployment safeguard.
